summary: Dogness (International) Corporation, a Cayman-incorporated, China-based pet products maker, filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt on October 19, 2026 of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter stating its Class A common shares no longer meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Rule 5550(a)(2) after 30 consecutive business days below that level. Trading continues uninterrupted on the Nasdaq Capital Market under DOGZ. A 180-day compliance period runs to April 19, 2027, with a possible second 180-day period requiring other continued listing standards and a reverse split if elected. Watch for reverse-split announcements and extension filings; no deal terms involved.
